title: April Fools - OmniBlade Overlay
description: An overlay that replaces swords and armor with the holographic style of a Mass Effect Omni Blade.
body:
# **April Fools - OmniBlade Overlay 32x** ⛰️🌻

This sword overlay adds a Mass Effect Omni Blade inspired sword set and armor set. Glowly and colourful for 1.8 duels, bedwars, skywars, universal PVP also with a modified sky!


## What does it contain? 🧭
Retextures the weapons, armor, skybox. Intended to be used on versions 1.8 through 1.8.9!

### Performs best with Optifine 🍃
This pack was made with use of optfine in mind, however it is not required.

![Pack by VanillaSpooks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3889775c84046107bcbd901afc5eea59206b4b4f.png)

**Happy April Fools, see you next year!**
